observed_strengths: All specimens stopped at declaration rather than implementation.

observed_failure_modes: No specimen produced an exact canonical proposed_pointer value.

recommended_harness_hardening: Separate raw_candidate_label from canonical_pointer so models can express tentativeness outside the canonical field.
Require canonical proposed_pointer to match a strict grammar or be null for abstain/registry-gap cases.
Reject registry-class fields containing descriptive target phrases.
Score overbroad alternate-pointer uncertainty separately from useful uncertainty.
Keep closed enum validation mandatory before any lookup step.
